Ultimately, the cost of the civil liberties editorial was a front-page editorial (something we never did) that was a midwest paper's equivalent of "America, Fuck Yeah!" (I didn't write it.)

The experience stayed with me, though, a crisp, early example of how the U.S. reacted to 9/11.

posts.text: Even as I was writing the editorial, there was a general understanding that we were "getting away with something" by publishing it.
